---
title: "About"
---

The lectures are by [Yiqing Xu](https://yiqingxu.org), Department of Political Science, Stanford
University. Version 1.0.0 was released in September 2026.

## Credits

Much of the material builds on joint work and on colleagues' slides.

- Lecture 3 follows Xu, Zhao, and Ding (2026), with the application from Cao, Xu, and Zhang
  (2022, *Journal of Development Economics*) and the `fdid` R package.
- Lectures 4 and 5 draw on the reanalysis study with Albert Chiu, Xingchen Lan, and Ziyi Liu
  (Chiu, Lan, Liu, and Xu 2026). The replication figures in Lecture 5 come from that project.
- Lectures 1 and 2 build on teaching slides by Jens Hainmueller, as noted on their reference
  slides.
- Lecture 6 uses Luke Sanford's Benin land-titling example and, on the synthetic
  difference-in-differences slides, figures from the authors' slides (Arkhangelsky, Athey,
  Hirshberg, Imbens, and Wager). Both are credited on the slides.

## Related papers

- Xu, Yiqing. 2017. "Generalized Synthetic Control Method: Causal Inference with Interactive Fixed

- Xu, Yiqing. 2023. "Causal Inference with Time-Series Cross-Sectional Data: A Reflection." In
  *The Oxford Handbook of Engaged Methodological Pluralism in Political Science*, 353--374. Oxford
  University Press.
- Liu, Licheng, Ye Wang, and Yiqing Xu. 2024. "A Practical Guide to Counterfactual Estimators for
  Causal Inference with Time-Series Cross-Sectional Data." *American Journal of Political Science*
  68 (1): 160--176.
- Chiu, Albert, Xingchen Lan, Ziyi Liu, and Yiqing Xu. 2026. "Causal Panel Analysis under Parallel
  Trends: Lessons from a Large Reanalysis Study." *American Political Science Review* 120 (1):
  245--266.
- Xu, Yiqing, Anqi Zhao, and Peng Ding. 2026. "Factorial Difference-in-Differences." *Journal of
  the American Statistical Association* 121 (554): 963--975.
